translator.method: LLM translator subagent per locale, reading the English catalogue and its context sidecar and the locale's own existing namespace for terminology; no MT service referenced. Session began on anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 and was moved to radient/auto by provider-quota fallbacks before the translation was written.

auditors.scope: Round 2: six changed keys (copy gate for design D2/D3); earlier round out of scope.

independence: Independent auditor: a separate subagent run from the translator's, which authored none of the strings as delivered and wrote its receipts before the ledger row was assembled. The findings/resolved_findings split in this receipt is the auditor's own. Neither translator nor auditor was a native speaker of the locale; that limitation is recorded below.

scope: Round 2: the six keys changed by the D2/D3 copy round. The rest of the namespace was audited in an earlier round and is out of scope here.
notes: ui.ownerAudit.viewer is retired in every catalogue; the removal is part of this round and was checked by the auditor.

findings.detail: Lexical stem repeated three times in two sentences: "Les messages précédents ne sont pas encore affichés. Chargez les messages précédents pour lire ce qui précède." Faithful (English repeats "older" twice too) and the second sentence must keep charging the same phrase as the ui.ownerAudit.older button, so left unfixed; only a future round wanting to break the repetition would reword the first sentence (e.g. "Les messages plus anciens ne sont pas encore affichés.").

"L'appartenance de votre cheffe de cabinet à cette conversation n'a pas pu être confirmée." uses "appartenance" for membership while this namespace's own ui.ownerAudit.active says "Votre cheffe de cabinet est toujours membre." Correct French and membership is not a pinned term, so left open; "le statut de membre" would align the two if a future round wants one noun.

limitations: No native-speaker review: translation and audit were both LLM agents.
The audit ran on radient/auto after provider-quota fallbacks from anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.
No rendered frame in any of the seven locales was reviewed; only the English surface was captured.
